title: Jesus, The Shop Hasn't Made A Profit In A Year 🏪
topic: his small shop hasn't turned a profit in a year and he can't tell hope apart from stubbornness

bible.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... the shop hasn't made a profit in a year. 🏪

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone says shut it down. I don't know if I'm hopeful anymore or just stubborn.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Stubbornness leans on your own plan. Hope leans on Me. They can look alike for a while. They don't feel alike.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But hope doesn't pay rent. I'm scared to keep going and scared to stop.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I fill you with joy and peace while you trust Me. Not after the till fills up. The full heart comes first.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Abounding hope isn't a full till. It's a full heart while the till is still filling.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What would you keep going for if hope was all you had left?
